name: Remove Curse

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Touch creature/object; end all curses affecting it; cursed magic item retains curse but attunement breaks so item can be removed/discarded.

rules.text: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end.
If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner’s Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.
